title: Title Transfer, Continued Furnishing and Purchase Election in Durable Medical Equipment Rentals
content:
When paid rental months reach the cap, the Durable Medical Equipment Rentals payment class decides whether the item becomes the patient's or stays the supplier's.

## Clauses

**(a) Title at the cap.** When the paid rental months reach the class's rental cap and the class passes ownership to the patient at the cap, title passes to the patient on the day after the last capped month ends, and maintenance and servicing becomes payable every servicing interval of the class where the class pays maintenance and servicing after the cap. When the last capped rental month is paid and title passes, the placement becomes owned.

**(b) Supplier-owned classes.** Where title does not transfer (oxygen equipment, frequently serviced equipment) the supplier keeps ownership and must keep furnishing the item for the class's continued-furnishing months after the cap, without rental payment.

**(c) Purchase option.** Where the class's purchase-option month is not zero the patient is offered the purchase option in that rental month, and may decline it and keep renting where the class allows the option to be declined. An elected purchase is paid at the purchase amount less the rental months already paid. When the patient elects the option, the placement becomes purchased, title passes on the date the purchase option took effect, and the purchase is paid on that date.

**(d) Purchase at delivery.** An item delivered as a purchase becomes purchased on its delivery date, title passes on that date, and the purchase is paid on that date.

**(e) Servicing visits.** A payable maintenance and servicing visit on owned, purchased or capped equipment is paid against the servicing interval it covers, identified by the first day of that interval.

## Ownership outcomes at a glance

| Situation | Ownership | Date title passes | Payment that follows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cap reached in a class that passes title at the cap | Patient (owned) | Day after the last capped month ends | Maintenance and servicing every servicing interval, where the class pays it after the cap |
| Cap reached in a class where title does not transfer | Supplier | Title does not pass | Continued furnishing for the class's months, without rental payment |
| Purchase option elected | Patient (purchased) | Date the option took effect | Purchase, at the purchase amount less the rental months already paid |
| Delivered as a purchase | Patient (purchased) | Delivery date | Purchase, paid on the delivery date |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- **Title date.** If the last capped rental month of a hypothetical placement ends on 14 March, title passes on 15 March.
- **Elected purchase.** A hypothetical placement with a purchase amount of $5,000.00 and one rental month already paid at $500.00: the elected purchase is paid at $5,000.00 less $500.00, which is $4,500.00.
- **Declining.** In a class that allows the option to be declined, a patient who declines the option keeps renting.
